name: DORA Metrics
description: All four DORA keys from git signals (deploy = *deploy* tag, configurable; hotfix/release/feature merges): deployment frequency, lead time (median+p90), change-failure rate, failed-deployment recovery — with Elite/High/Medium/Low tiers, weekly trends, and a deterministic suggestions engine plus AI analysis. Rust sidecar (compiles on first enable via `cargo run`).
